document.abstract: The IVC-9000 Servo System is designed to control tape motion and tension through all modes of operation. The reel controller, capstan, scanner, and tension systems are all position servos interacting to control precise transducers capable of accurate performance. Digital techniques have been applied throughout the system, providing such features as controlled lock-up and error memories for edit mode operation. Compact modular packaging provides convenience, and reliable, long-life design provides assurance of good performance.
